fact_text: The analyst says the Pakistan market is entering a bull cycle for FY2027, which he expects may run alongside global bull markets at least until the FIFA World Cup ends.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Volatility usually rises as June-quarter results start to come out, and results were then about 10 to 15 days away; the analyst sees that period as a poor time to take new positions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: The analyst thinks the budget was less favourable to EVs than the government had earlier suggested, with the measures not turning out as had been signalled.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: The BYD (Build Your Dreams) EV plant, in which a stake of up to 50% is held, targets 25,000 EVs and is expected to be complete in FY2027.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Hub Power's EPS has recovered rather than fallen in recent years, even though its IPP projects such as Narowal have been renegotiated, which the analyst cites as a point in its favour.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Hub Power holds about a 47-48% stake in China Power Hub Generation and receives circular-debt payments from its IPP projects, which the analyst counts as a durable strength.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Hub Power's management has paid Rs 5 per share every quarter for several years, and the analyst says the dividend could rise if the BYD plant adds earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: The analyst says Hub Power's forward P/E, based on upcoming earnings, is below about 9 to 10 times.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's dividend yield is about 8%, and the analyst describes it as an evergreen dividend payer over many years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: The analyst says a holding of around 65% linked to Askari Bank has not yet been reflected in Fauji Fertilizer's share price, and Askari's Islamic branch news is worth watching.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX IPO Revenue & FY2027 Bull Cycle | PTCL-Telenor Takeover | Midday Flash 1 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-01)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's urea dispatches were good in April and May 2026, according to the analyst.

fact_text: Urea and DAP application for rice planting starts in July, so fertilizer offtake is expected to pick up in that season.

fact_text: Lucky Cement is the number one cement maker in Pakistan, with a capacity of about 15 million tonnes.

fact_text: Lucky's standalone accounts show no loss position, and coal costs are cheaper because the company reportedly sources coal from Tanzania.

fact_text: Lucky's consolidated group accounts include distribution of EVs from a Chinese brand, which the analyst expects to show in the group results.

fact_text: Lucky Core Industries is building a pharma portfolio through acquisitions of companies linked to multinational pharma, which the analyst says investors should follow.

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement's normal earnings were about Rs 8 to 9 per share, and the analyst expects the price to catch up once capacity expansion lifts earnings.

fact_text: Maple Leaf took on a loan of about 80 billion, and the analyst expects capacity expansion to be used to service that debt.

fact_text: The analyst says about 10 IPOs were expected in the first half of 2026, which makes listing fees on the Pakistan Stock Exchange more important.

fact_text: The analyst says the Pakistan Stock Exchange's investments in CDC, NCCPL and eServices have become significant on its books.

fact_text: The analyst expects Ufone's market share and tele-density to rise after the Telenor takeover, giving a magnified organic effect in PTC's group accounts, with the six-month accounts seen as important.

fact_text: The analyst expects OGDC's income to rise as output from several fields improves, and says the company is working toward 500 barrels per day from one field.
